title: Moving to a New City
description: Four recordings about moving to a new city: two friends, a call to a flat agent, a city tour and a message from a sister.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Big news
parts.intro: You will hear two friends, Peter and Mai, talking about a move.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: Hi, Mai! You look happy today. What's the news?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I got a job in Manchester! I start in September, so I'm moving there next month.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: That's fantastic! But it's a long way. How will you get there?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: By train. It takes about two hours from here. I thought about driving, but I don't have a car, and the parking there is expensive.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: What will you do with all your things?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm going to give away most of my books and clothes. My new flat is small, so I can only take two suitcases and a few boxes.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: I can help you carry them, if you like. I have a free weekend.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh, thank you, Peter! That's kind. But I'm a little nervous. I don't know anybody in Manchester.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: Don't worry. You are very friendly, and you'll make friends quickly. And I'll visit you at Christmas.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'd love that. Now, let's have a coffee. My treat!

parts.title: Part 2 · Finding a flat
parts.intro: You will hear Nam phoning an agent, Ms Clark, about a flat.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Good morning, Clark Homes. How can I help?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hello. I'm moving to the city next month, and I'm looking for a flat. I saw one on your website with two bedrooms.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Yes, that's on Park Street. It's very nice, with a small balcony. The rent is six hundred pounds a month.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That's a little high for me. I'll share it with a friend, so we'll pay three hundred each. Is it near a bus stop?

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Yes, the bus stop is just two minutes away, and the supermarket is across the road.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Perfect. Are pets allowed? I have a small cat.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: I'm afraid not. The owner doesn't like animals. But there's another flat on River Road where cats are fine.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hmm, I'd like to see both. Can we visit on Thursday afternoon?

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Of course. Let's say three o'clock. Please bring your passport and your job letter.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I will. Thank you, Ms Clark. See you on Thursday.

parts.title: Part 3 · A city tour
parts.intro: You will hear a guide welcoming new students to a city tour.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Welcome to the city, everybody! My name is Sophie, and I am going to show you the most important places.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: First, on your left, you can see the library. It's free to join, and it's open every day until nine o'clock at night.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Next, we are going to walk to the market square. There is a fruit and vegetable market there on Wednesdays and Saturdays. The food is fresh and cheaper than in the supermarket.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: If you feel lonely, join a club! There is a chess club, a dance group and a walking club. Most of them meet on weekday evenings.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Now, a small warning. The weather here changes quickly. It can be sunny in the morning and rainy by lunchtime, so always carry an umbrella.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Finally, our tour ends at the café by the river. The first drink is on me. Please follow me!

parts.title: Part 4 · A message from home
parts.intro: You will hear Linh leaving a message for her brother, who has moved to a new city.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Minh! It's Linh. How is your new life? Mum and Dad ask about you every day.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I know you're busy with your new job, so I'll be quick. First, Mum wants you to phone her on Sunday. She says she doesn't want to worry, but she does!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Second, I found your old camera under my bed. Do you want me to send it? It's very easy to post, and you can take photos of the city.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Third, we want to visit you in the spring. Dad says the weather will be warmer in April, so that's better than March.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Don't forget to eat well, OK? I know you are not good at cooking. Try making rice with eggs. It's cheap and easy!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Anyway, I miss you a lot. Call me when you have time. Bye for now!
